ownership: United States federal government public data
allowed_use: use of the complete selected Census ZCTA5 polygon set as the authoritative spatial denominator for analyses explicitly scoped to that Census layer and vintage
redistribution with source and vintage metadata
prohibited_use: representing ZCTAs as exact USPS delivery-route boundaries
representing the ZCTA5 polygon denominator as the universe of current or deliverable USPS ZIP Codes
assigning a polygon to a ZIP+4 or to a USPS ZIP5 that has no corresponding Census ZCTA5 polygon
adding a probabilistic confidence percentage to direct Census-published geometry
removing source, vintage, or generalization metadata from published derivatives
retention: Indefinite for source releases and derived public-data artifacts unless a project retention rule is approved.
redistribution: Allowed with provenance, source vintage, transformation version, and stated limitations.
